intro: Build the enduring issue sentence. Choose the right piece for each blank.
sentence_frame: The enduring issue is ___: ___. We see it when ___.

tiles.text: people who hold power use it against people who have no say
new tools change the world around people
distant places start depending on each other
Catherine's government punishes serfs who complain about their landlords
Catherine calls delegates together to write new laws
Europeans trade with the Mughal Empire

correct_sentence: The enduring issue is Power & Its Abuse: people who hold power use it against people who have no say. We see it when Catherine's government punishes serfs who complain about their landlords.
hints: Each blank has to match the others: the name, the definition and the example.
Which example shows power used against people with no say?
rationale: Naming, defining and showing have to line up. Punishing serfs for complaining is power used against people with no say, which is Power & Its Abuse.
